title: Purification of ATP13A4 from HEK293T cells
author: Sarah van Veen
materials: Determine protein concentration of supernatant via nanodrop.

steps.title: Seed HEK293T Cells
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293T cells (with stable ATP13A4 expression, generated via lentiviral transduction) into 500 cm2 dishes at a density appropriate to achieve 70-80% confluency by the following day. Allow cells to attach and grow for approximately 24 hours.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Gently detach and harvest the cells by scraping them into PBS.

steps.title: Wash and Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in PBS and centrifuge to pellet the cells.

substeps.instruction: Spin cells down at 400 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Perform initial cell lysis and mechanical disruption on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cell pellet in 25 mL LIS buffer and keep on ice for 15 minutes.
Add 25 mL 1M buffer and apply 30 up-and-down strokes on ice.
Transfer to Dounce homogenizer and apply 60 up-and-down strokes on ice.
Centrifuge for 20 minutes at 2000 rpm and 4 °C; keep the supernatant.

steps.title: Secondary Lysis
steps.instruction: Process the remaining cell pellet to maximize yield.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the resulting cell pellet in 25 mL LIS buffer and keep on ice for 15 minutes.
Add 25 mL 1M buffer and apply 30 up-and-down strokes on ice.
Transfer to Dounce homogenizer and apply 60 up-and-down strokes on ice.
Centrifuge for 20 minutes at 2000 rpm and 4 °C; keep the supernatant.

steps.title: Combine Supernatants
steps.instruction: Combine the supernatants from the primary and secondary lysis steps.

steps.title: Solubilize Protein
steps.instruction: Solubilize the protein using DDM and CHS.

substeps.instruction: Add DDM (supplemented with CHS at a DDM:CHS ratio of 10:1) at three times the amount of protein concentration in the supernatant (e.g., if protein is 10 mg/mL, add DDM to reach 30 mg/mL).
Solubilize for 3 hours at 4 °C in a head-over-head rotator.
Spin at 11000 rpm at 4 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Affinity Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the solubilized protein to Strep-Tactin®XT beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL prewashed Strep-Tactin®XT beads to the supernatant.
Bind overnight in a head-over-head rotator at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resin Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound protein using a column setup.

substeps.instruction: Pour the mixture into a large column and allow it to drip through by gravity flow.
Wash resin twice with 10 column volumes of wash buffer 1.
Wash resin twice with 10 column volumes of wash buffer 2.

steps.title: Protein Elution
steps.instruction: Elute ATP13A4 using SSR buffer supplemented with 50 mM biotin (E0-6).

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate Strep-Tactin®XT resin by washing with 10 column volumes of SSR buffer (300 x g, 4 °C, 3 minutes).
Elution 0: Add 150 µl elution buffer and collect eluate (E0).
Elution 1: Add 150 µl elution buffer, incubate for 5 minutes in head-over-head rotator at 4 °C, and collect eluate (E1).
Elution 2: Add 150 µl elution buffer, incubate for 5 minutes in head-over-head rotator at 4 °C, and collect eluate (E2).
Elution 3: Add 150 µl elution buffer, incubate for 5 minutes in head-over-head rotator at 4 °C, and collect eluate (E3).
Elution 4: Add 150 µl elution buffer, incubate for 5 minutes in head-over-head rotator at 4 °C, and collect eluate (E4).
Elution 5: Add 150 µl elution buffer, incubate for 5 minutes in head-over-head rotator at 4 °C, and collect eluate (E5).
Elution 6: Add 150 µl elution buffer, incubate for 5 minutes in head-over-head rotator at 4 °C, and collect eluate (E6).

steps.title: Quality Control and Quantification
steps.instruction: Analyze the purity and concentration of the eluted protein.

substeps.instruction: Analyze purification quality using SDS-PAGE followed by Coomassie staining or immunoblotting.
Estimate protein concentration by running an SDS-PAGE gel with BSA standards and staining with Coomassie dye.
